tasks.label: Grafana: Open Dashboard (kiosk)
args: if (Get-Command msedge -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { Start-Process msedge -ArgumentList "--app='${env:GRAFANA_DASHBOARD_URL}?kiosk=tv'" } elseif (Get-Command chrome -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { Start-Process chrome -ArgumentList "--app='${env:GRAFANA_DASHBOARD_URL}?kiosk=tv'" } else { Start-Process "${env:GRAFANA_DASHBOARD_URL}?kiosk=tv" }

tasks.label: Grafana: Create Snapshot (fetch dashboard then snapshot)
args: try { $apiUrl = '${env:GRAFANA_API_URL}'; if (-not $apiUrl) { throw 'GRAFANA_API_URL not set' }; $key = '${env:GRAFANA_API_KEY}'; if (-not $key) { throw 'GRAFANA_API_KEY not set' }; $dashUrl = '${env:GRAFANA_DASHBOARD_URL}'; if (-not $dashUrl) { throw 'GRAFANA_DASHBOARD_URL not set' }; Write-Host 'Fetching dashboard JSON from Grafana...'; $uid = ($dashUrl -split '/d/')[1] -split '/' | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $uid) { throw 'Cannot extract dashboard UID from GRAFANA_DASHBOARD_URL' }; $dashResp = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$apiUrl/api/dashboards/uid/$uid" -Headers @{ Authorization = "Bearer $key" } -Method Get; $dashboardJson = $dashResp.dashboard; if (-not $dashboardJson) { throw 'Failed to retrieve dashboard JSON' }; Write-Host 'Posting snapshot request...'; $payload = @{ dashboard = $dashboardJson; name = "Demo snapshot $(Get-Date -Format yyyyMMddTHHmmss)"; expires = 3600 } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20; $snapResp = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$apiUrl/api/snapshots" -Headers @{ Authorization = "Bearer $key"; 'Content-Type' = 'application/json' } -Method Post -Body $payload; if ($snapResp.url) { Write-Host "Snapshot created: $($snapResp.url)" } else { Write-Host 'Snapshot response:'; $snapResp | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 } } catch { Write-Error $_.Exception.Message; exit 1 }
